issue.title: Stop artifact-link aggregate rebuilds from SIGKILLing apollo's publication and backfill chops
issue.description: agent_publication and artifact_link_backfill finish inside their budgets because aggregate previews build one cheap snapshot, write retries respect the deadline, and slow drains leave progress breadcrumbs.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/artifact_link_aggregate_timeouts.md requests this work

issue.title: Build the artifact-link event snapshot once and reuse its inputs
issue.description: Make preview_aggregate build one event snapshot instead of two (resolves task bead sase-1rt). Add a scoped, opt-in memo for durable event objects and the parsed pending outbox, so repeated snapshots inside one publish, drain, or reconcile stop re-reading and re-validating unchanged inputs.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/artifact_link_aggregate_timeouts.md defines phase snapshot-reuse as one work unit

issue.title: Gate aggregate write retries and publish rebuilds on the caller deadline
issue.description: Make _write_merged_aggregate stop retrying after a lost CAS race when the next preview cannot finish before the caller's deadline. Thread the deadline through rebuild_aggregate, reconcile_aggregate, and the publish-path apply_events_to_aggregate, with typed deferral handling in both chops. Add per-sub-phase publish timings.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/artifact_link_aggregate_timeouts.md defines phase deadline-aware-aggregate as one work unit

issue.title: Stream per-stage progress from agent_publication project drains
issue.description: Give drain_project a progress callback, so a slow or killed agent_publication tick leaves breadcrumbs for the stage it was in. Log the link drain's phase timings, including the new publish sub-phases, the same way artifact_link_backfill already logs its drain phases.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/artifact_link_aggregate_timeouts.md defines phase publication-drain-progress as one work unit

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: docs/reference/automation/notification-gates.md is 6,009 words (cap 6,000) so `lint (docs contract)` fails just check on the clean base; already recorded under sase-1uu.1 (related sase-1sr tracks a separate schema correction on that page).

Implemented publish_deferral = retain. _write_merged_aggregate(deadline=) raises ArtifactLinkAggregateWriteDeferred (attempts, last_compute_seconds) after a lost CAS when now+last_compute >= deadline, or before the first compute when already expired; deadline=None keeps 5 attempts with a forced last. Threaded through rebuild_aggregate, reconcile_aggregate (returns on-disk aggregate + "reconcile deadline expired; aggregate write deferred after a concurrent writer"), reconcile_and_repair (skips dangling_scan/repair), apply_events_to_aggregate and _publish_event_objects_locked (aggregate_ready=False, deferred=True, diagnostic "artifact-link aggregate projection deferred past deadline"). Report.phase_seconds lists admission/states/roots/local_receipts/beads/aggregate; drain appends publish.<name> after publish; backfill drain-phases line prints them after publish. Behavior change worth knowing: an already-expired deadline now defers the publish aggregate rebuild too, so test_outbox_deadline_retains_operations_then_retry_acks_once now expects all 3 rows retained, then 3 drained on retry (uses==1).

Verified: new tests for deadline-gated _write_merged_aggregate (defer / retry / expired / deadline=None), reconcile deferral + repair skip, backfill deferral without record_reconcile, publish retain outcome + six phase_seconds, drain publish.* keys, and backfill log line all pass; tests/sdd (560) and agents_sync + backfill suites pass; ruff and mypy clean. sase tool run check passed every lint gate except docs contract (notification-gates.md 6,009/6,000 words, fails identically on the clean base). just test-scoped escalated to the full lane: 62720 passed, 4 failed — one was mine (monkeypatch.undo in a publisher test, fixed); the other two real failures (test_continuation_retention, test_app_import_budget) reproduce on the clean base and are recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UPs. Epic-symbols clear.
